tools.name: check_linkedin_post
tools.description: Check a LinkedIn post before publishing: character count against LinkedIn's 3000-character limit, the text likely shown before "see more" on desktop, a hook score, Markdown that LinkedIn will not render, placeholders, and phrases that read as AI-written. Returns concrete issues to fix.

tools.name: format_linkedin_post
tools.description: Convert Markdown into text that pastes cleanly into LinkedIn: **bold** and headings become Unicode bold, *italic* becomes Unicode italic, list markers become bullets, Markdown links become plain URLs. Optionally replaces em dashes.

tools.name: style_linkedin_text
tools.description: Restyle a short piece of text with Unicode letters that keep their look when pasted into LinkedIn (bold, italic, bold italic, serif, cursive, strikethrough, underline). Use sparingly; screen readers may read styled letters poorly.

tools.name: generate_linkedin_hooks
tools.description: Opening-line templates for a LinkedIn post, filled with the user's topic, audience and result. Anything the user has not supplied stays in [brackets] to replace with a real detail; nothing is invented.

tools.name: generate_linkedin_headlines
tools.description: Profile headline options built only from the user's role, audience, outcome, proof and keywords. Every option fits LinkedIn's 220-character headline limit. Does not change the profile.

tools.name: preview_linkedin_post
tools.description: Return a link to an approximate preview of the post in the LinkedIn feed on mobile and desktop, including about where "see more" cuts it. Pass author_name and author_headline when you know them. Opening the link saves and publishes nothing. The post text travels in the link, so share it only with pe

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_linkedin_post, format_linkedin_post, preview_linkedin_post · Public sink: check_linkedin_post, format_linkedin_post, generate_linkedin_hooks, preview_linkedin_post · Destructive: format_linkedin_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_linkedin_post, format_linkedin_post, preview_linkedin_post · Public sink: check_linkedin_post, format_linkedin_post, generate_linkedin_hooks, preview_linkedin_post · Destructive: format_linkedin_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
